correctness.rationale: For 0<=alpha<1, 0<=mu<=1, c=1-alpha and B=1+2c, the Carathéodory/Schur expansion expresses (mu a2a4-a3²)/c²=Kt⁴+At²v-v²+(4mu/3)tw, v=(1-t²)x, w=(1-t²)[(1-|x|²)y-tx²]. The quadratic majorant in rho=|x| is convex nondecreasing on [0,1] because 0<=4mu/3<=4/3. The resulting u=t² envelope is bounded by max(1,-K) from H<=2max(1,|K|), with switch mu*=3c/(1+2c). Generalized Koebe and odd functions attain each branch; scalar slices and rank-one derivative inversion give the radial extension on every nonzero complex Banach ball, not nonradial maps. Independent symbolic rational coefficient expansion confirmed the Schur-parameter identity; bounded sample alpha,mu verified envelope, not a substitute for global inequalities.
